scope: Unapplied B03/M04/F11 helper and apply recipe, with directly needed current native/API and typed recovery source contracts only.

findings.finding: The helper accepts any ART-descendant pins JSON, parses it and hashes arbitrary ROOT/row[path] references without verifying the fixed recipe pins filename/raw SHA or exact expected source-path inventory first. Absolute paths override ROOT and parent components can escape it, so a substituted public pins document can induce prohibited private-file reads before any source refusal.
findings.minimal_fix: Require the exact fixed pin filename/path and expected raw SHA256 23fcbbf875a250e9e3460293f977e91bc261515c09c49d5212b4bce9208a3d5d. Capture it once with bounded protected bytes and parse those same bytes. Validate exact reviewed path inventory, schema, unique normalized relative paths and digest forms before dereferencing any row; reject absolute/parent/unknown refs before reading.
findings.minimal_regression: Use isolated public mock pin documents naming an absolute/parent/private-looking sentinel and a trap reader; demonstrate refusal before the trap is called. Also reject omitted/extra/duplicate source names and changed pin bytes without reading any real private file.

findings.finding: The checked digest and parsed proof_raw come from separate path reads. A replacement/read/restore seam can supply uncommitted parsed identity/run facts while initial/final path digests match the expected original. Later refs hash the restored path, so reported proof identity and retained proof commitment need not describe the bytes actually used.
findings.minimal_fix: Capture the fixed selected public proof once with a bounded protected reader, compare SHA256 of that exact raw capture to paper_proof_sha256, and parse it. Bind facts and artifact refs to that capture; final protected reread must equal captured bytes. Avoid hash-then-independent-read admission.
findings.minimal_regression: Use two isolated public proof byte strings and a swap/restore reader seam. A different parse capture must fail even if path digests before/after match the expected file. Valid same-capture input must retain exactly its expected commitment; no DB/native execution needed.
